Akhilesh Yadav Condemns Ayodhya Demolitions, Promises Compensation

Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has condemned demolition drives in Ayodhya, promising compensation to those affected if his party returns to power. The demolitions occurred in Ayodhya.
